summary: Sound object destructor (thiscall): installs the destructor-stage vtable off_5ACE3C, runs the three-stage vtable release TripleVTableDestructorRelease, restores the base vtable off_5ACE2C, and frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when a2 bit 0 is set. Returns this.

operations.description: Run the three-stage vtable destructor release chain TripleVTableDestructorRelease(this).
Restore the base vtable: *this = off_5ACE2C after the release chain.
Guard on a2 bit 0 (a2 & 1); when set, the object itself is freed.
Free the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set (final release).
